description: AK-13. Copy of valid/minimal in which contrast=high sets color.text.default to a mid grey: #666666 on #f2f2f2 (light, 5.14:1) and #8a8a8a on #1a1a1a (dark, 5.04:1). Every contrast=default combination passes (>= 15:1); both contrast=high combinations fail the text-normal threshold 7:1. APCA shortfalls in the same combinations are advisory warnings only.
